summary:
## Standing operator rules
Always pin new licensing tools to an exact version in `requirements/license-tools.txt` rather than using >= or a floating latest version.

Never remove a response field from ledgerly; mark it deprecated and retain it for at least 180 days after its first deprecation notice.

Keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Current objective
Fix webhook signature verification failures causing customer 400s in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`. Invoice migration is paused.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Active schema: `billing_v3`; never seed or write into frozen `billing_v1` (superseded). `current_request_id`; `amount_cents_legacy`; PostgreSQL database `billing`. FastAPI DB dependencies require `Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)]`. Recurrence combines date, local time, and timezone before UTC conversion.

## Ruled-out approaches
Increasing Celery `visibility_timeout` to six hours; stuck jobs became invisible for hours. Direct database-session defaults triggered Ruff B008; use `Annotated`.

## Plan and progress
Invoice column addition/backfill/NOT NULL are done. Webhook investigation is pending; no webhook command has been issued.

## Recent work
Added `tests/test_currency_rounding.py` covering scales, half-cent, negative, zero, exception, and mixed inputs; focused tests and full suite passed. Full suite: 184 passed, 2 skipped. Stripe verification remains unresolved.
